messages:
Alex: Quick async pulse for the quarterly milestone — short status + asks. TL;DR: auth-v2 is ready for canary next week, storage schema bump is blocking downstream tests, and we still have a telemetry gap on session rehydration.
Maya: thanks — can you list the exact owners for the blockers?
Alex: Owners: auth-v2 rollout = Maya (PM) + Sanjay (eng), storage schema = StorageTeamLead, telemetry gaps = Toni.
Sanjay: auth-v2 PRs merged except #4512 (last cleanup), requesting one more review from @Toni for the metrics hooks.
Toni: will do a quick pass today. minor comments only — should be clearable.
StorageTeamLead: schema bump requires a short migration window (20m) and a minor change to the S3 path layout. We can schedule this during the canary ramp if everyone agrees.
Maya: schedule preference: Wed 02:00 UTC or Thu 08:00 UTC. Wed avoids customer peak but conflicts with infra maintenance. Thoughts?
Sanjay: Wed is fine if CI-bot confirms no platform maintenance window.
CI-bot: infra-maintenance check: no maintenance windows scheduled for Wed 02:00 UTC.
Alex: OK, tentatively Wed 02:00 UTC then — Sanjay please coordinate with StorageTeamLead to reserve the migration window.
Maya: next, telemetry: we discovered ~15% of sessions drop rehydration tokens in canary logs. @Toni can you add an eval event and a short alert rule?
Toni: adding eval event now: `session.rehydrate.failure` with tags {release:auth-v2}. I’ll put a 5-min alert at 10% threshold and a quiet period of 10m.
Alex: thanks. Also calling out rollout plan: start at 5% for 1h, 20% for 2h, full if no regressions. Rollback on error rate > 1.5x baseline or 10% rehydrate failures.
Sanjay: deploy command I’ll run for canary:
```
./deploy --service=auth --version=auth-v2 --canary=5 --monitor=10m
```
Maya: two quick asks for owners before Wed: 1) Sanjay — drop a short checklist in the PR with the migration steps and rollback playbook; 2) StorageTeamLead — a one-line compatibility note for the API change.
StorageTeamLead: will add the compatibility note and migration steps to the doc by EOD today.
Sanjay: checklist added to PR #4512: MIGRATE.md + rollback commands. ping @Maya for verification.
Maya: verified.
Alex: final: code review pings — if you are listed as owner please ack the PR or assign a reviewer now so we don’t stall. We need clears by EOD tomorrow to keep Wed window.
Toni: acked PRs assigned. :thumbsup:
StorageTeamLead: acked.
CI-bot: scheduled canary job created for 1718300000 (internal run id: canary-2026-05).
Alex: great — I’ll follow up with a short postmortem template to capture any regressions after the ramp. If anything slips, post here and we’ll re-plan. Thanks all.
